stated: Strengthen the Groceries Code Adjudicator to protect consumers from unfair price rises and support producers.

source.quote: Strengthen the Groceries Code Adjudicator to protect consumers from unfair price rises and support producers.

bearing_set.reason: The policy explicitly targets consumer food prices by strengthening a regulator empowered to curb unfair pricing practices by major supermarkets, directly affecting a core component of the cost-of-living basket.

Supporting producers against unfair treatment by large retailers directly affects income security, payment terms, and job viability for farmers and food-supply workers — real wages and job security indicators in the food production sector.

membership_note: Two genuine bearings: O2 (consumer price protection — the stated primary purpose) and O4 (producer/supplier income security — the stated secondary purpose). The link to O13 (aggregate prosperity) or O14 (inequality) is too indirect to clear the non-negligible bar given the GCA's narrow sectoral scope.
